question: How many orders are paid?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'paid';

question: Top 3 customers by order amount
gold_sql: SELECT c.email, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.email ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Orders per segment
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment;

question: Cancellation rate
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled')::numeric / COUNT(*) AS cancel_rate FROM sales.orders;

question: Average order amount per VIP customer
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(o.amount) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'vip';

question: Daily revenue trend
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', order_ts) AS d, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d;

question: Customers with > 1 order
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales.orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
